title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
reason: Reveals a controversial and unprecedented governance action by Arbitrum to move hack funds, raising serious security and centralization concerns.

sources.summary: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.

title: Liquid’s bitcoin IOUs are fully backed again after a $320 million exploit
reason: Confirms the resolution of a significant security exploit, a key milestone for trust in the Liquid network.

sources.summary: A final 250 BTC transfer closed the hole left by September’s bug, but the federation behind the network still hasn’t said who paid to fill it.
